_comment: Recorded hook-dispatch latency baseline. Method pinned in src/scripts/bench_hook_latency.ts; budgets in src/config/hook-latency-budget.json. The baseline MUST come from the environment the gate runs in (GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest) — a locally recorded darwin baseline made the 20% regression window measure the environment offset instead of real regressions. These values are the bench step's own output from CI run 30303438406/30303438480 (2026-07-27); refresh from a CI run's printed table, or via --update ONLY on a comparable linux runner.
